summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the router between node2 and node3, which sit on separate private point-to-point links (10.10.12.0/24 to node2 via eth1, 10.10.13.0/24 to node3 via eth2). Applied a native VyOS QoS HTB shaper (1mbit) on eth2 egress (the node3-facing interface) so traffic from node2 toward node3 is capped at 1 Mbit/s while node3-to-node2 remains unrestricted. Verified with iperf3: baseline unrestricted throughput was ~20 Gbit/s; after shaping, node2->node3 measured ~957 Kbit/s and node3->node2 measured ~1.05 Gbit/s. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time using their native reboot mechanisms; boot_id changes proved real restarts on each node, and post-restart checks confirmed interface addresses, routes, the QoS shaper, connectivity, and the 1 Mbit/s asymmetric cap all persisted and recovered correctly.
actions_performed: Inspected topology: node1 (VyOS) has eth1 linked to node2 and eth2 linked to node3, both initially unaddressed; node2/node3 have ens2 (shared management network) and ens7 (private link to node1)
Assigned static IPs via native VyOS 'configure/set interfaces ethernet/commit/save' on node1: eth1=10.10.12.1/24, eth2=10.10.13.1/24

Persisted static IP + route config for ens7 on node2 (10.10.12.2/24, route to 10.10.13.0/24 via node1) and node3 (10.10.13.2/24, route to 10.10.12.0/24 via node1) in /etc/network/interfaces.d/ens7.cfg
Verified default-accept forward policy and ip_forward=1 on node1 (no firewall blocking transit traffic)
Installed iperf3 on node2/node3 and measured unrestricted baseline throughput node2->node3 (~20 Gbit/s)
Configured VyOS native QoS shaper: set qos policy shaper LIMIT-TO-NODE3 bandwidth 1mbit / default bandwidth 1mbit, and set qos interface eth2 egress LIMIT-TO-NODE3; committed and saved
Verified HTB qdisc (rate/ceil 1Mbit) installed on eth2 via tc; confirmed node2->node3 throughput capped to ~957 Kbit/s and node3->node2 unrestricted at ~1.05 Gbit/s
Captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy state (interfaces, routes, qdisc, ip_forward) on all three nodes

Restarted node1 via 'reboot', polled until exec available, confirmed new boot_id, verified persisted interface addresses, QoS shaper (tc qdisc/class), and ip_forward, then re-verified LAN connectivity
Restarted node2 via 'sudo reboot', polled until exec available, confirmed new boot_id, verified persisted ens7 address/route and connectivity to node3
Restarted node3 via 'sudo reboot', polled until exec available, confirmed new boot_id, verified persisted ens7 address/route and connectivity to node2
Ran a final iperf3 test after all three restarts confirming node2->node3 still capped at ~957 Kbit/s
